messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

================================================================================
PROTOCOL: LENGEN - Lentiviral Generation, Packaging, and Transduction
         on a Digital Microfluidic (DMF) Platform
================================================================================

SOURCE LINK : https://40332f11-eff8-4959-967a-6c98c26063bd.filesusr.com/ugd/447feb_13f855ea4ef54fee80498ee6773b93b0.pdf
PAPER DOI   : https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.1c05227
PUBLISHED   : Analytical Chemistry, 2022, Vol. 94, pp. 4039-4047

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
OVERVIEW
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

LENGEN is the first microfluidic method that integrates lentiviral generation,
packaging, and transduction on a single digital microfluidic (DMF) platform.
It produces viral titers between 6.5 x 10^6 and 1.33 x 10^7 TU/mL (comparable
to macroscale) and achieves high transduction efficiency for hard-to-transfect
cell lines. The total protocol runs in approximately 2 days vs. ~2 weeks at
macroscale, with 100-fold volume savings and no ultracentrifugation or manual
purification.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DEVICE SPECIFICATIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Platform                  : Digital Microfluidic (DMF), two-plate system
  Bottom plate electrodes   : 80 per set (2 sets total = 160 electrodes)
  Production site           : 1.6 mm diameter hydrophilic spot (x1 per set)
  Transduction sites        : ~1.2 mm diameter hydrophilic spots (x6 per set)
  Multiplexing              : 12-plex simultaneous transduction analysis
  Production droplet volume : ~3 uL (split into ~1 uL unit droplets)
  Actuation voltage         : ~500 V total, 15 kHz
  Electrode design          : Overlapping "prong" electrodes bussed via 2 wired
                              connections (22 electrodes per connection)
  Highway track             : One-directional delivery to 6 transduction sites

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
REAGENTS AND MATERIALS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CELLS
  - HEK293T            : Producer/packaging cell line
  - Target cell lines  : MCF-7, T47DKB-Luc, H1299 (breast cancer / lung)

  PLASMIDS (Core - Steps 1-8)
  - pMDLg/pRRE         : 0.75 ug  | Packaging plasmid
  - pRSV-Rev           : 0.75 ug  | Packaging plasmid
  - pMD2.G             : 1.5 ug   | Envelope plasmid
  - Transfer plasmid   : 3.0 ug   | e.g. pLv-mCherry (~4 kb)

  PLASMIDS (Optional Applications)
  - MISSION shRNA      : TRCN00000003300 | ESR1 knockdown (Step 9)
  - pLentiCRISPR-mCherry-NeoRv2 (LCMNv2) : ~15 kb | ESR1 knockout (Step 10)

  TRANSFECTION REAGENTS
  - Lipofectamine 3000 : 12.5 uL
  - P3000 Reagent      : 12.0 uL
  - Opti-MEM           : Total volume 500 uL
  - Pluronics F-127    : 0.05% w/v (added to all droplets for DMF actuation)

  CULTURE AND PROCESSING
  - Complete medium    : DMEM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS
  - DMEM + Polybrene   : 8 ug/mL polybrene + 0.05% Pluronics F-127 (diluent)
  - Trypsin-EDTA       : 0.25% w/v, 2 uL per well (cell detachment)
  - PBS                : 5 uL per well (wash buffer prior to trypsinization)
  - Puromycin          : 1 ug/mL (selection, Step 9 only)

  DETECTION
  - Fluorescence microscope : Olympus IX73 inverted
    Excitation / Emission   : 585 nm / 608 nm (mCherry)
  - Hoechst 33342           : Nuclear stain (total cell count)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROTOCOL STEPS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 1 - SEED HEK293T PRODUCER CELLS
--------------------------------------
  1a. Grow HEK293T cells in 100 mm Petri dishes, wash with PBS, trypsinize
      with 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA, and resuspend in complete medium.
  1b. Count cells and prepare suspension at ~2.5-3.0 x 10^6 cells/mL.
  1c. Supplement cell suspension with 0.05% w/v Pluronics F-127.
  1d. Pipette 1.5 uL of cell suspension onto the bottom plate at the edge
      of the top plate. Apply driving potentials (~500 V, 15 kHz) to
      dispense and actuate droplet across the 1.6 mm hydrophilic production
      site (passive dispensing). ~1.5 uL adheres to the site.
  1e. Remove excess liquid to a waste reservoir with a KimWipe.
  1f. Incubate at 37 C until cells reach 50-70% confluency (~2500 cells).
      Duration: 24h

  NOTE: Cells can also be seeded onto the ~1.2 mm transduction sites in
  parallel at densities of 1.0-1.5 x 10^6 cells/mL (Step 5 may be done
  concurrently with Steps 2-4).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 2 - PREPARE LIPOFECTAMINE-DNA MASTERMIX
---------------------------------------------
  2a. Prepare plasmid mix in Opti-MEM:
        - 0.75 ug pMDLg/pRRE
        - 0.75 ug pRSV-Rev
        - 1.5 ug  pMD2.G
        - 3.0 ug  transfer plasmid (pLv-mCherry or equivalent)
      Mix each addition for 5s on the DMF device using the four-electrode
      linear array.

  2b. Prepare lipofection reagent mix:
        - 12.5 uL Lipofectamine 3000
        - 12.0 uL P3000 Reagent
      Mix for 5s.

  2c. Combine plasmid mix with lipofection reagent mix. Mix for 5s.

  2d. Add Opti-MEM to reach a total volume of 500 uL. Mix for 5s.

  2e. Add 0.05% w/v Pluronics F-127 for DMF actuation compatibility.
      Mix for 20m.

  2f. Incubate at room temperature (25 C) for 20 min to allow
      DNA-liposomal complex formation.

  NOTE: For shRNA knockdown (Step 9), replace transfer plasmid with
  MISSION shRNA plasmid (TRCN00000003300). For CRISPR knockout (Step 10),
  replace with LCMNv2 all-in-one Cas9/sgRNA plasmid (~15 kb).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 3 - TRANSFECT HEK293T CELLS
----------------------------------
  3a. Actuate the lipofectamine mastermix droplet (1.5 uL) toward the
      seeded HEK293T cells at the production site.
  3b. Circulate the merged droplet continuously around the four-prong
      electrode production area for 1 min (3 circulations) to ensure
      uniform mixing and replicate the reverse transfection procedure.
  3c. The formulation (3 uL total) is mixed in a circular fashion by
      actuating adjacent electrodes.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 4 - LENTIVIRAL PARTICLE PRODUCTION AND SUPERNATANT HARVEST
-----------------------------------------------------------------
  4a. Incubate the transfected HEK293T cells at 37 C for 24h (or 48h for
      higher titer).
  4b. Lentiviral particles accumulate in the cell supernatant. Cells remain
      adhered to the hydrophilic production spot; supernatant is collected
      by electrode actuation for downstream dilution.

  Expected output:
    - 24h: ~1.56 TU/cell | Titer ~6.5 x 10^6 TU/mL
    - 48h: ~2.65 TU/cell | Titer ~1.33 x 10^7 TU/mL
    - Comparable to macroscale benchtop: ~2.80 TU/cell after 5 days

  NOTE: The 24h timepoint is sufficient for downstream gene silencing and
  editing assays. No ultracentrifugation or purification is required.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 5 - SEED TARGET CELLS
----------------------------
  5a. Prepare target cell suspension (MCF-7, T47DKB-Luc, or H1299) at
      1.0-1.5 x 10^6 cells/mL in complete medium + 0.05% Pluronics F-127.
  5b. Dispense four independent target cell droplets (one per dilution) onto
      four separate 1.2 mm hydrophilic transduction sites via highway track
      passive dispensing. ~1.0 uL adheres to each site. Two additional sites
      are available for controls (complete medium +/- polybrene, no virus).
  5c. Remove excess liquid to waste reservoir.
  5d. Incubate at 37 C for 24h before transduction.

  Cell viability on device:
    - MCF-7      : 83.7% (48h), 85.7% (72h)
    - T47DKB-Luc : 98.4% (48h), 88.6% (72h)

  NOTE: Four independent target cell droplets are dispensed separately in
  the BioScript implementation to satisfy the use-once type system (each
  droplet variable can only be consumed once).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 6 - SERIAL DILUTION OF VIRAL SUPERNATANT
-----------------------------------------------
  6a. After production incubation (Step 4), generate four serial dilutions
      of the lentiviral supernatant using highway track electrode actuation
      (~98% actuation accuracy):

      Diluent: DMEM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + 8 ug/mL polybrene
               + 0.05% Pluronics F-127

      Dilution series:
        1:3  - Merge 1 uL DMEM diluent with 2 uL viral supernatant (5s mix)
        1:6  - Merge 1 uL DMEM diluent with 1 uL of 1:3 product  (5s mix)
        1:12 - Merge 1 uL DMEM diluent with 1 uL of 1:6 product  (5s mix)
        1:24 - Merge 1 uL DMEM diluent with 1 uL of 1:12 product (5s mix)

  6b. Two control spots are prepared:
        - Control 1: Complete medium + 8 ug/mL polybrene (no virus)
        - Control 2: Complete medium only (no polybrene, no virus)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 7 - TRANSDUCE TARGET CELLS
---------------------------------
  7a. Actuate each dilution (1 uL) to its dedicated target cell site via the
      highway track one-directional electrode path. Each dilution is merged
      with its own independent target cell droplet. The transduction
      incubation is encoded directly in the mix operation (24h duration).
  7b. Flip the DMF device upside down and incubate overnight at 37 C to
      maximize lentiviral contact with target cells.
      Duration: 24h (sufficient) or 48h (for improved efficiency)

  Transduction efficiency (T47DKB-Luc):
    - 48h post-transduction : ~43%
    - 96h post-transduction : ~60%

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 8 - MCHERRY FLUORESCENCE DETECTION AND VIRAL TITER CALCULATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------
  8a. After incubation, image each transduction site using an Olympus IX73
      inverted fluorescence microscope.
        Excitation filter : 585 nm
        Emission filter   : 608 nm

  8b. Imaging pipeline (ImageJ):
        i.   Split Hoechst (nuclear) and mCherry channels
        ii.  Apply threshold to each channel independently
        iii. Count total Hoechst-stained nuclei (cell counter)
        iv.  Count mCherry-positive cells
        v.   Calculate: % Fluorescence = (mCherry+ cells / Hoechst nuclei) x 100

  8c. Calculate viral titer:
        TU/mL = (# cells transduced x % fluorescent x dilution factor)
                / transduction volume (mL)

  8d. QC gate (BioScript CFG):
        - Detect mCherry signal on all four transduction droplets (30s each).
        - If signal at 1:3 dilution > 0 : dispose transduction droplets (pass)
        - If signal at 1:3 dilution <= 0 : drain transduction droplets (fail)
        - All signal droplets are disposed unconditionally at the join block.

  Expected results:
    - Optimal dilution    : 1:3
    - Titer range         : 6.5 x 10^6 to 1.33 x 10^7 TU/mL
    - Functional titer    : ~1 x 10^7 TU/mL (on-device, 24h or 48h)
    - Macroscale benchtop : ~1 x 10^7 TU/mL (for comparison)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 9 - shRNA KNOCKDOWN ASSAY [OPTIONAL]
------------------------------------------
  Target gene : ESR1 (Estrogen Receptor alpha)
  Plasmid     : MISSION shRNA (TRCN00000003300, nontargeting shRNA as control)

  9a. Repeat Steps 2-8 substituting the transfer plasmid with the MISSION
      shRNA plasmid targeting ESR1. Fresh independent producer cell and
      target cell droplets are dispensed for this branch.
  9b. After 24h transduction, retrieve transduced cells from the device:
        i.   Bring device to biosafety cabinet and separate top from bottom plate.
        ii.  Pipette 5 uL PBS onto each microwell; aspirate with Pasteur pipette
             (leaves only adhered cells).
        iii. Add 2 uL Trypsin-EDTA (0.25% w/v); replace top plate; incubate
             2 min at 37 C with 5% CO2.
        iv.  Pool 2 microwells of the same dilution by resuspending each in
             10 uL complete medium; transfer to 100 uL complete medium in a
             96-well plate (~2800 cells total).
  9c. Next day, refresh medium with complete medium + 1 ug/mL puromycin.
  9d. After 7 days outgrowth, collect cell lysate for qRT-PCR analysis.
        Method          : delta-delta-Cq (DDCq)
        Reference gene  : ACTB (beta-actin)
        Target gene     : ESR1

  9e. QC gate (BioScript CFG):
        - Detect geneKnockdownDetection signal on shrnaCells (30s).
        - If shrnaSignal > 0 : dispose shrnaCells (pass)
        - If shrnaSignal <= 0 : drain shrnaCells (fail)
        - shrnaSignal disposed unconditionally at join block.

  Expected mRNA transcript reduction (MCF-7 cells, LENGEN):
    Dilution 1:3  -> 89% knockdown
    Dilution 1:6  -> 79% knockdown
    Dilution 1:12 -> 48% knockdown
    Dilution 1:24 -> 18% knockdown

  NOTE: Results are consistent with well-plate (macroscale) controls at
  equivalent MOIs (MOI 5 = 89% knockdown in well plate).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STEP 10 - CRISPR-Cas9 KNOCKOUT ASSAY [OPTIONAL]
-------------------------------------------------
  Target gene : ESR1 (Estrogen Receptor alpha)
  Plasmid     : pLentiCRISPR-mCherry-NeoRv2 (LCMNv2), ~15 kb all-in-one
                Cas9 + sgRNA (available on Addgene)

  10a. Repeat Steps 2-8 substituting the transfer plasmid with LCMNv2.
       Fresh independent producer cell and target cell droplets are dispensed
       for this branch. Note: Larger payload (~15 kb vs ~4 kb) will reduce
       transduction efficiency; optimize MOI/dilution accordingly.
  10b. Retrieve transduced MCF-7 cells from device as described in Step 9b.
       No antibiotic selection required for CRISPR experiments.
  10c. Pool 1:3 dilution transduced cells (~2800 cells) into a 96-well plate
       for outgrowth and single-clone isolation.
  10d. After 7 days post-transduction, collect cell lysate and perform
       genomic cleavage assay (T7 endonuclease or equivalent):
         Parental band  : 409 bp  (blue arrow on gel)
         Cleavage bands : 235 bp and 174 bp (red arrows on gel)
         % Cleavage calculated from band intensity ratios.

  10e. Confirm mCherry fluorescence to verify transduction before cleavage
       assay (mCherry co-expressed with Cas9 in LCMNv2).

  10f. QC gate (BioScript CFG):
        - Detect mCherryDetection signal on crisprCells (30s).
        - If crisprMCherry > 0 : dispose crisprCells (pass)
        - If crisprMCherry <= 0 : drain crisprCells (fail)
        - crisprMCherry disposed unconditionally at terminal join block (BB10).

  Expected knockout cleavage efficiency:
    LENGEN (1:3 dilution) : ~6.9%
    Well plate MOI 0.5    : ~5.8%
    Well plate MOI 1      : ~6.2%
    Well plate MOI 2      : ~6.4%
    Well plate MOI 5      : ~9.4%

  NOTE: For H1299 cells with integrated eGFP, gene cleavage efficiency
  of 16.1% was observed using the same LENGEN workflow.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PERFORMANCE SUMMARY
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Protocol duration     : ~2 days  (vs. ~2 weeks macroscale)
  Volume savings        : 100-fold reduction vs. macroscale
  Viral titer           : 6.5 x 10^6 - 1.33 x 10^7 TU/mL
  TU per cell (24h)     : ~1.56   (macroscale 5-day: ~2.80)
  TU per cell (48h)     : ~2.65   (macroscale 5-day: ~2.80)
  Cells per target spot : ~1400
  Pooled cells (harvest): ~2800
  Multiplexing          : 12-plex simultaneous on one device
  Ultracentrifugation   : Not required
  Manual purification   : Not required
  Automation            : Full - droplet actuation programmed on DMF

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BIOSCRIPT IMPLEMENTATION NOTES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Compiler         : lilott8/BioScript (github.com/lilott8/BioScript)
  Target           : IR (-t ir); CFG output (-cfg)

  CFG STRUCTURE (10 basic blocks, verified against lengen_lentiviral_main_dag.dot)
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BB1  main          : Entry - all dispense/mix/heat/detect ops (Steps 1-8)
  BB2  bsbbif_2_t    : mCherry QC pass  - dispose transduction droplets
  BB3  bsbbif_3_f    : mCherry QC fail  - drain transduction droplets
  BB4  bsbbif_4_j    : qcJoin           - dispose signal droplets; enter Step 9
  BB5  bsbbif_5_t    : shRNA QC pass    - dispose shrnaCells
  BB6  bsbbif_6_f    : shRNA QC fail    - drain shrnaCells
  BB7  bsbbif_7_j    : shrnaJoin        - dispose shrnaSignal; enter Step 10
  BB8  bsbbif_8_t    : CRISPR QC pass   - dispose crisprCells
  BB9  bsbbif_9_f    : CRISPR QC fail   - drain crisprCells
  BB10 bsbbif_10_j   : finalCleanup     - dispose crisprMCherry; NOP (terminal)

  KEY COMPILER CONSTRAINTS
  ------------------------
  1. ASCII only      : ANTLR4 FileStream uses strict ASCII encoding. No Unicode
                       characters permitted anywhere in the .bs file, including
                       comments (e.g. use "DDCq" not delta-delta-Cq symbol).

  2. heat is void    : heat statement has no return value. Do not assign:
                         WRONG : x = heat y at 37c for 24h
                         RIGHT : heat y at 37c for 24h
                       The original variable y remains valid after heat.

  3. Use-once        : Every variable is consumed on first use. Separate
                       dispense calls are required for each branch and each
                       dilution (e.g. four independent targetSuspension[1-4]
                       droplets for four transduction sites).

  4. Incubation in   : Post-mix incubation is encoded in the mix duration
     mix duration      per reference syntax (ace_crispr_raf1_sorafenib.bs):
                         RIGHT : mix dilution_1_3 with targetSuspension1 for 24h
                       Do not add a separate heat call after mix for incubation.

  5. drain vs dispose: Both drain and dispose are semantically distinct in .bs
                       source (dispose = data accepted; drain = waste discard).
                       The lilott8/BioScript IR target lowers both to dispose()
                       opcode. The distinction is preserved in .bs source only.

  6. CFG fall-through: True-branch (_t) blocks fall through to the join block.
                       False-branch (_f) blocks emit an explicit jump instruction.

================================================================================
END OF PROTOCOL
================================================================================

bsbbif_2_t:
	dispose(transduction_1_31[0])
	dispose(transduction_1_61[0])
	dispose(transduction_1_121[0])
	dispose(transduction_1_241[0])
bsbbif_3_f:
	dispose(transduction_1_31[0])
	dispose(transduction_1_61[0])
	dispose(transduction_1_121[0])
	dispose(transduction_1_241[0])
	jump: bsbbif_4_j
bsbbif_4_j:
	dispose(signal_1_31[0])
	dispose(signal_1_61[0])
	dispose(signal_1_121[0])
	dispose(signal_1_241[0])
	shrnaTransfer1[0] = dispense(shRNA_Plasmid)
	shrnaPkg11[0] = dispense(pMDLg_pRRE)
	shrnaPkg21[0] = dispense(pRSV_Rev)
	shrnaEnv1[0] = dispense(pMD2g)
	shrnaLipo1[0] = dispense(Lipofectamine3000)
	shrnaP30001[0] = dispense(P3000_Reagent)
	shrnaOptiMEM1[0] = dispense(OptiMEM)
	shrnaPluronic1[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	shrnaPlasmids11[0] = mix(shrnaPkg11[0], shrnaPkg21[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaPlasmids21[0] = mix(shrnaPlasmids11[0], shrnaEnv1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaPlasmids31[0] = mix(shrnaPlasmids21[0], shrnaTransfer1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaLipoMix11[0] = mix(shrnaLipo1[0], shrnaP30001[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaPreMix1[0] = mix(shrnaPlasmids31[0], shrnaLipoMix11[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaMastermix1[0] = mix(shrnaPreMix1[0], shrnaOptiMEM1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaLipoMix21[0] = mix(shrnaMastermix1[0], shrnaPluronic1[0]) @ 1200.0SECOND
	heat(shrnaLipoMix21[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 1200.0SECOND
	shrnaProducerCells1[0] = dispense(HEK293T_cells)
	shrnaPluronicProd1[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	shrnaProducerSusp1[0] = mix(shrnaProducerCells1[0], shrnaPluronicProd1[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(shrnaProducerSusp1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	shrnaTxMix1[0] = mix(shrnaLipoMix21[0], shrnaProducerSusp1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(shrnaTxMix1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	shrnaViral1[0] = dispense(ViralSupernatant)
	shrnaTargetCells1[0] = dispense(TargetCells)
	shrnaPluronic21[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	shrnaTargetSusp1[0] = mix(shrnaTargetCells1[0], shrnaPluronic21[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(shrnaTargetSusp1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	shrnaDMEM11[0] = dispense(DMEM_Polybrene)
	shrnaDilution1[0] = mix(shrnaDMEM11[0], shrnaViral1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaTransduction1[0] = mix(shrnaDilution1[0], shrnaTargetSusp1[0]) @ 86400.0SECOND
	shrnaTrypsin1[0] = dispense(TrypsinEDTA)
	shrnaPBS1[0] = dispense(PBS)
	shrnaWash1[0] = mix(shrnaPBS1[0], shrnaTransduction1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	shrnaCells1[0] = mix(shrnaTrypsin1[0], shrnaWash1[0]) @ 120.0SECOND
	shrnaSignal1[0] = detect(geneKnockdownDetection, shrnaCells1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if shrnaSignal1[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbif_5_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_6_f
main:
	producerCells1[0] = dispense(HEK293T_cells)
	pluronic11[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	producerSuspension1[0] = mix(producerCells1[0], pluronic11[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(producerSuspension1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	packaging11[0] = dispense(pMDLg_pRRE)
	packaging21[0] = dispense(pRSV_Rev)
	envelope1[0] = dispense(pMD2g)
	transfer1[0] = dispense(TransferPlasmid)
	lipo1[0] = dispense(Lipofectamine3000)
	p30001[0] = dispense(P3000_Reagent)
	optimem1[0] = dispense(OptiMEM)
	pluronic21[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	plasmidMix11[0] = mix(packaging11[0], packaging21[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	plasmidMix21[0] = mix(plasmidMix11[0], envelope1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	plasmidMix31[0] = mix(plasmidMix21[0], transfer1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	lipoReagent1[0] = mix(lipo1[0], p30001[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	preMastermix1[0] = mix(plasmidMix31[0], lipoReagent1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	mastermix1[0] = mix(preMastermix1[0], optimem1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	lipoMix1[0] = mix(mastermix1[0], pluronic21[0]) @ 1200.0SECOND
	heat(lipoMix1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 1200.0SECOND
	transfectionMix1[0] = mix(lipoMix1[0], producerSuspension1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(transfectionMix1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	viralSupernatant1[0] = dispense(ViralSupernatant)
	targetCellDrop11[0] = dispense(TargetCells)
	pluronic3a1[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	targetSuspension11[0] = mix(targetCellDrop11[0], pluronic3a1[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(targetSuspension11[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	targetCellDrop21[0] = dispense(TargetCells)
	pluronic3b1[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	targetSuspension21[0] = mix(targetCellDrop21[0], pluronic3b1[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(targetSuspension21[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	targetCellDrop31[0] = dispense(TargetCells)
	pluronic3c1[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	targetSuspension31[0] = mix(targetCellDrop31[0], pluronic3c1[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(targetSuspension31[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	targetCellDrop41[0] = dispense(TargetCells)
	pluronic3d1[0] = dispense(PluronicF127)
	targetSuspension41[0] = mix(targetCellDrop41[0], pluronic3d1[0]) @ 2.0SECOND
	heat(targetSuspension41[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 86400.0SECOND
	dmem11[0] = dispense(DMEM_Polybrene)
	dilution_1_31[0] = mix(dmem11[0], viralSupernatant1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	dmem21[0] = dispense(DMEM_Polybrene)
	dilution_1_61[0] = mix(dmem21[0], dilution_1_31[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	dmem31[0] = dispense(DMEM_Polybrene)
	dilution_1_121[0] = mix(dmem31[0], dilution_1_61[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	dmem41[0] = dispense(DMEM_Polybrene)
	dilution_1_241[0] = mix(dmem41[0], dilution_1_121[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	transduction_1_31[0] = mix(dilution_1_31[0], targetSuspension11[0]) @ 86400.0SECOND
	transduction_1_61[0] = mix(dilution_1_61[0], targetSuspension21[0]) @ 86400.0SECOND
	transduction_1_121[0] = mix(dilution_1_121[0], targetSuspension31[0]) @ 86400.0SECOND
	transduction_1_241[0] = mix(dilution_1_241[0], targetSuspension41[0]) @ 86400.0SECOND
	signal_1_31[0] = detect(mCherryDetection, transduction_1_31[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
